approved.en: Russia continues airstrikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, killing civilians in Zaporizhzhia and striking power plants in Kyiv, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. Ukraine hit a Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile maintenance base, and Russian forces restricted Starlink access, disrupting front-line operations. Russian authorities detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. President Trump announced a diesel deal with Russia framed as an energy ceasefire, which Ukraine called false after further strikes. The UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ukraina rammet en russisk Iskander-M ballistisk missil-vedlikeholdsbase, og russiske styrker begrenset Starlink-tilgang, noe som forstyrret frontoperasjoner. Russiske myndigheter holdt en japansk journalist i varetekt på spionasjebestand, og president Trump kunngjorde en dieseldel med Russland som ble fremstilt som et energivåpenhvile, noe Ukraina kalte falskt etter ytterligere angrep. UCDP registrerte 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In Gaza, Israeli air strikes killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and a girl was rescued from a flaming apartment after an attack, while the Israeli Yellow Line advanced, leaving displaced residents with nowhere to go. The Israeli government is pursuing the reopening of settler Route 463, which would further isolate Ramallah. An article describes Israel's use of AI in Gaza as a tool of genocide. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Students on the same hike fashioned tourniquets from belts and socks after the blast. Hezbollah announced compensation for Lebanese homeowners whose houses were destroyed and unveiled an aid plan for displaced civilians. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk under en fottur nær Libanongränsen, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som fikk IDF-sjefen til å beordre en undersøkelse og myndighetene til å vurdere restriksjoner på fotturer. Studenter på samme tur laget tourniquetter av belter og sokker etter eksplosjonen. Hezbollah kunngjorde erstatning til libanesiske huseiere hvis hus ble ødelagt og presenterte en hjelpsplan for fortrengte sivile. UCDP registrerte 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024.

Iran is accused of planning attacks on UK military sites, with MI5 warning of a shift toward harder targets and the UK sanctioning two Iranian nationals after an alleged IRGC plot at RAF Fairford. Iranian officials claim some incidents are false-flag operations in response to the UK accusations. The conflict now directly threatens Saudi oil infrastructure, regional air travel, and UK security, with 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israeli drones struck a Syrian operative planning attacks for Iran near the Lebanon border, prompting a UN Security Council call for respect of the 1974 Disengagement Agreement. The Syrian army began destroying chemical weapons stockpiles and the UK allocated $90 million to support Syria's economic recovery. Jordan and Syria’s foreign ministers discussed bilateral ties and regional developments. 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi forces continue air operations against ISIS hideouts in Kirkuk, using F-16 jets, while the government raised military readiness to the highest level and prioritized air defence amid regional tensions. The supreme court declared the Kurdistan Region security law unconstitutional and the Iraqi cabinet is being completed in a Thursday parliament session. Iraq detained 74 border infiltrators and advanced a security wall, and Prime Minister Barzani discussed security and investment with U.S. Consul General Wendy Green. The Iraqi National Security Advisor presented a strategic neutrality stance at MERI 2026. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Høyesterett erklærte sikkerhetsloven i Kurdistan-regionen grunnlovsstridig, og den irakiske regjeringen blir ferdigstilt i en torsdagssesjon i parlamentet. Irak har arrestert 74 grenseinntrengere og videreført en sikkerhetsmur, og statsminister Barzani diskuterte sikkerhet og investeringer med USAs konsulgeneralsekretær Wendy Green. approved.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces have launched air strikes on gold mining sites along the Sudan-Egypt border, killing dozens of miners, while the Rapid Support Forces used a paramilitary drone to strike near the Ethiopian frontier, causing additional casualties. These attacks extend fighting into civilian mining areas and the border triangle region, threatening civilians in West Kordofan. The war has already produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP. The new element is the targeting of gold mines and the use of a drone strike, expanding the conflict beyond traditional battle lines into resource sites and border zones.
approved.nb: Den sudanske hæren (SAF) har gjennomført luftangrep på gullgruveområder langs grensen mellom Sudan og Egypt, og drept dusinvis av gruvearbeidere, mens RSF-militsen brukte en paramilitær drone til å angripe nær grensen mot Etiopia, noe som førte til ytterligere tap. Disse angrepene utvider kampene til sivile gruveområder og trekantregionen ved grensen, og truer sivilbefolkningen i Vest-Kordofan. Krigen har allerede forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP. Det nye elementet er målrettingen av gullgruver og bruken av droneangrep, som utvider konflikten utover tradisjonelle frontlinjer til ressurssteder og grenseområder.

approved.en: Intercommunal clashes in Rumbek have killed dozens of civilians, prompting caretaker governor Rin Tueny to return to Lakes State, while a curfew was imposed to curb the violence. Two SSPDF soldiers were wounded in an attack on a Mundri West military outpost, and the U.S. Embassy condemned an assault on WFP workers in Jonglei that involved looting of aid. A Juba High Court sentenced five officers to 24 years for a raid on a general's home, and Pibor appealed to Jonglei authorities to return 81 abducted women and children. The lethal communal violence now far exceeds the two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Vold mellom folkegrupper i Rumbek har drept dusinvis av sivile, noe som fikk midlertidig guvernør Rin Tueny til å returnere til Lakes State, mens et portforbud ble innført for å dempe volden. To soldater fra den sudanske hæren (SAF) ble såret i et angrep på en militærpost i Mundri West, og den amerikanske ambassaden fordømte et angrep på WFP-arbeidere i Jonglei som innebar plyndring av hjelp. En høyesterett i Juba dømte fem offiserer til 24 år for et raid på en generals hjem, og Pibor appellerte til myndighetene i Jonglei om å returnere 81 bortførte kvinner og barn. Den dødelige volden mellom folkegrupper overstiger nå langt de to dødsfallene i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Joseph Kabila, former president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, has joined the M23 rebels and is now leading a broader political-military front that includes additional anti-government forces. The coalition’s formation expands the rebel alliance beyond M23 alone and is fighting the Congolese army in North Kivu. Security personnel linked to Erik Prince were ambushed, resulting in the death of a former New Zealand special forces officer and wounds to former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy. The conflict remains deadly, with 1,158 battle-related deaths recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Venezuelan authorities have taken a fugitive businessman into US custody on bribery charges while President Maduro appears in court and a judge denied medical bail for Cilia Flores, prompting solidarity rallies. The United States arrested a soldier who allegedly earned $400,000 betting on Maduro's removal, and energy firms are recruiting former US officials to access Venezuelan oil as Eni and Repsol advance a FLNG project. Cuba’s grid collapse is worsening regional energy strain, and Starlink internet is now permitted to operate in Venezuela, expanding communications capability. 2 battle-related deaths in 2007 were recorded, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Venezuelanske myndigheter har tatt en flyktig forretningsmann i amerikansk varetekt på bestikkelsesanklager mens president Maduro møter i retten og en dommer avslo medisinsk kausjon for Cilia Flores, noe som har ført til solidaritetsdemonstrasjoner. USA arresterte en soldat som angivelig tjente 400 000 dollar på å satse på Maduros avsettelse, og energiselskaper rekrutterer tidligere amerikanske tjenestemenn for å få tilgang til venezuelansk olje mens Eni og Repsol viderefører et FLNG-prosjekt. Cubas strømbrudd forverrer den regionale energikrisen, og Starlink-internett er nå tillatt å operere i Venezuela, noe som utvider kommunikasjonsmulighetene. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2007 ble registrert, ifølge UCDP.
